name: suede-code
description: Suede AI code review and A-F ship grade for a diff, PR, branch, or commit range: findings ranked P0-P3 with file:line evidence and a fix path, an A-F grade across seven lanes with Instant-F security triggers and surface grade caps, OWASP 2025 checks, a deploy-safety gate, a commit-dirt scan, and fix briefs. Three modes: full review and grade in one pass (default), findings only with no grade, and grade only with no findings list. Use when asked to review this, grade this, find the bugs before me
author: JasonColapietro
